name: Losing Lodam
summary: Historical English negative trick-taking game where players avoid capturing high-point loader cards.
rules_text: Use a 52-card pack, aces high. Loaders score penalty: Ace 11, Ten 10, King 3, Queen 2, Jack 1. Each player starts with 3 lives and antes to a pool. Deal equal hands clockwise, leftover cards form a face-down talon. No trumps at start. Eldest leads; follow suit if able else discard any card. The first player unable to follow turns the top talon card to set trumps for the deal, then returns it. Highest trump or highest of led suit wins trick and leads next. If any player reaches 31+ loader points in won tricks they immediately lose a life and the deal ends. If all tricks are played, the player with most loader points loses a life. A player with 31+ may challenge another; points are counted and the erring player loses a life. Between tricks a player with an unguarded loader may offer to swap a court for a court or Ace/Ten for Ace/Ten; if same suit the swap is void. When a player loses third life they are out; last player remaining wins the pool.
